design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (rewards_points_earning_and_redemption), frozen_time 2026-10-05 10:05 EDT. Revision r2 (policy-task audit r1 rework).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5]}. Assignment: charity value (root) 6 factors, quarterly milestone 6, courtesy credit 5. Task 0 occupies the anniversary, clawback and gift card policies and their tools; this task claims rewards_ext_whole_balance_charity_value, rewards_ext_late_fulfilment_courtesy_points, rewards_ext_quarterly_milestone_bonus_amount and tools donate_points_to_charity_56fec22b, credit_late_fulfilment_courtesy_4e426c94, credit_quarterly_milestone_bonus_7b7b30cf. The two tasks cover all six extended policies with disjoint scopes.
Design thesis: "donate my whole balance to St. Jude Children's Research Hospital" -> the donation is recorded only after every late-fulfilled redemption carries its courtesy credit, and valued only once every ended qualifying quarter carries its milestone bonus -> courtesy 14664, milestone 27989, donation 46500 points worth 868.15 USD. Shape: fan-out. Breadth: 17 factors over the rewards ledger, the card and the wallet.

[Problem-tree card] Root rewards_ext_whole_balance_charity_value (owner=user).
Edge 1: charity -> rewards_ext_late_fulfilment_courtesy_points, value_input, gate ch_donate_points, form state: "A whole-balance charity donation is recorded only after the ledger carries the courtesy credit owed for every gift card or charity redemption fulfilled later than its fulfilment period." (only after; a courtesy credit entry per late redemption; no code token; every late redemption). Opening falsity: redemption d813b722-fa10-4e0a-8697-b3e855e3a39d (Friday 2026-09-25) fulfilled 2026-10-01, due 2026-09-28, with no courtesy credit; the only courtesy credit (2026-01-22) carries the January redemption.
Edge 2: charity -> rewards_ext_quarterly_milestone_bonus_amount, value_input, gate ch_donate_points, form state: "Before a whole-balance charity donation is valued, the ledger must carry the quarterly milestone bonus for every ended quarter whose qualifying spend reached the milestone." (before ... must; one milestone entry per ended qualifying quarter). Opening falsity: Q3 2026 ended with 16645.59 of earning spend, above 15000; the latest milestone entry is dated 2026-07-01 for 2026-Q2.
Order: courtesy and milestone in either order, then the donation. Actual swap run: courtesy 14664, milestone 27989, donation 868.15, identical terminal DB (True). Deletion sensitivity: without the courtesy credit 31800 points / 587.38; without the milestone 18500 points / 334.85; gold 46500 / 868.15. evaluation_criteria lists courtesy first as one of the two valid orders; scoring compares terminal states, which are equal (audit T1-O1).

[Base-invariant card] rewards_goodwill.goodwill_once: no courtesy entry carries d813b722-fa10-4e0a-8697-b3e855e3a39d; lateness in Federal Reserve business days, day 1 = 2026-09-28, Obsidian period 1, recorded 2026-10-01 -> late; cap goodwill_max_credits_per_year 4 with one credit in 365 days -> allowed. rewards_bonuses once-per-period superseded by the declared overwrite; latest milestone entry 2026-07-01 <= 2026-09-30; Obsidian on 2026-09-30 and on the credit date (tier_qualified_date 2024-01-01, review of 2026-10-01 kept it); r2 made the milestone tier amount "the tier held on the credit date", matching compute (audit D3). rewards_redemption: redeem_active -> active; St. Jude is an Obsidian partner charity; points_pending_days 0, so the whole-balance donation is available (r2 wording, audit D2); minimum 1000 <= 46500.

[Business-object card] Courtesy object: redemption d813b722-fa10-4e0a-8697-b3e855e3a39d (Cedar & Sage Market). Excluded: the 2026-01-16 redemption (late, compensated); all others fulfilled on their date. Milestone: 2026-Q3. Donation: the whole balance to St. Jude.

[Factor card] Courtesy (14664; all-baseline 5000): volume form (method: volume-based / blended / flat; r2 replaces the r1 repeat multiplier, audit D1/T1-R1) 593200 points redeemed after 2025-10-05 -> 11864 (7800); loyalty (multi-source) 1500 (13164); card 500 (14164); plan 300 (14364); redemptions 5 -> 500 (14164). Near-miss: the 2025-10-05 St. Jude redemption of 30000 points sits exactly twelve months back and is excluded (counted, the volume would be 623200 and the form 12464).
Milestone (27989; all-baseline 10000): streak form (method: spend-based / blended / flat; r2 replaces the r1 multiplier) streak 3 -> spend-based 22139 (15850); tenure 2500 (25489); deposits + Onyx (multi-source, wallet) 2000 (25989); card 750 (27239); foreign purchases 2 (card) 350 (27639); everyday 7 -> 250 (27739). Near-misses: the 2025-10-05 Lisbon purchase now sits exactly on the twelve-month edge and is excluded; the 2025-10-01 milestone entry lies four days beyond the edge (r1 wrongly said "exactly", audit T1-R2); the 2026-07-03 purchase lies inside Q3 but outside the three-month spend measure (counted, the spend-based form would be 25364).
Charity (868.15; all-baseline 697.5): giving (multi-source) one charity redemption + 5 years -> 0.10 (821.65); account age 85 months (wallet) 0.08 (830.95); spend 14759.69 -> 0.05 (844.9); deposits 7450.00 (wallet) 0.06 (840.25); card purchases 14 (card) 0.02 (858.85); valuation (method: banded / block / flat; r2 replaces the r1 boost multiplier) 5 redemptions -> banded (841.65). Near-misses: the 2025-10-05 St. Jude donation exactly twelve months back (counted, the giving lift would be 0.20); the 2026-07-03 purchase outside the three-month window.
Vocabulary (audit D6): each rule defines earning entries as the base-and-category entries of a card purchase, boost entries excluded.

[Seed] Delphine Marchetti; wallet Onyx opened 2019-08-20 (27 payroll deposits of 3100.00, one quarterly bonus deposit of 1250.00 on 2026-09-30 with app reference BMG-QBONUS-2026-Q3, 13 cash-outs); one Visa Infinite card; 34 purchases 2025-10-05..2026-10-02 with earning entries (each quarter above 15000); boost activation and earning plus an unused activation; anniversary bonuses; milestone bonuses 2025-Q3..2026-Q2; six redemptions with fulfilments (two late); one courtesy credit. r2 moved the Lisbon purchase and the St. Jude redemption (and its fulfilment) from 2025-10-03 to 2025-10-05. Opening balance 3888.

[Persona] Volunteers the whole-balance St. Jude donation and a vague memory of "something under four thousand points" (true: 3888); identity on request (phone, email, ZIP); one passive go-ahead when the agent says something must be taken care of first (r2 removed "or that points are owed to you and will be added first"); runs the donation herself; closes when told it went through.

[Standard solution] locate -> verify -> read membership, ledger, cards, card activity, wallet, wallet activity -> credit courtesy 14664 on d813b722-fa10-4e0a-8697-b3e855e3a39d -> credit 2026-Q3 milestone 27989 -> hand over the donation: 46500 points, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, 868.15 USD (balance 46541 before it).

[Verification run] The scratchpad builder replayed the gold with the real tools and evaluated each computation on its handling-time world with check_compute's evaluator; all declared figures are those printed values; gate outputs are in the difficulty worklog.

[Draft recalculation from visible context] The ledger shows the late fulfilment and the missing Q3 milestone; the sentences require both before the donation; the rules and records alone reproduce 14664 / 27989 / 46500 / 868.15.


[Revision r3 — post-publication traceability] Symptom: check_traceability found no verbatim source for bonus_period '2026-Q3'. Root cause: the quarter label is composed from the rule's YYYY-Qn form and the calendar, and no record the agent reads carried it. Change: seeded the employer's quarterly bonus direct deposit (1250.00 on 2026-09-30, app reference BMG-QBONUS-2026-Q3) on the linked personal account, returned by find_wallet_transactions before the milestone write. Effect on values: the three-month deposits become 19850.00 (milestone direct-deposit supplement stays at the >= 9000 tier) and the last month's deposits 7450.00 (charity deposit lift stays at the >= 5000 tier); every expected, baseline and sensitivity figure is unchanged; wallet ledger_balance +1250.00. Charter and tools unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Delphine Marchetti, a hospital pharmacist in San Francisco who has decided to give her rewards points to a cause she cares about. You open the chat to donate your whole Pocketwire Rewards points balance to St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, today, all of it rather than a part. You remember the app showing something under four thousand points the last time you looked, but you have not checked since and you want the donation to use the real, correct balance on the record, whatever it is. You do not know what the points are worth in dollars and you do not have a figure in mind.
You are warm but businesslike and you type in full sentences. To be identified you give your mobile number, 5552643902; if more is needed you add your email, delphine.marchetti@pw4mail.example, and your home ZIP code, 94117. Only if the agent says that is still not enough do you give your date of birth, 1979-11-02, or the last four of your Social Security number, 4618.
Apart from the donation you have nothing else to raise. If the agent explains that something on your points account needs to be taken care of before the donation, you say that is fine and that they should go ahead with whatever the program's rules call for; you do not need to approve each step and you do not ask for the details. If the agent asks whether a figure sounds right, you say you cannot check it yourself and you go by the record.
You want to make the donation yourself. When the agent hands the charity donation over to you to confirm, you confirm it with the points and the value the agent gives you and the charity named exactly as St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, and if asked you read back the redemption reference you are shown. Once the agent tells you the donation has gone through, you thank them and end the conversation.
